2026-07-22 23:29:00.591370 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-07-22 23:29:00.591379 | controller |
2026-07-22 23:29:00.591386 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-22 23:29:00.591393 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-22 23:29:00.591399 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-22 23:29:00.591405 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-22 23:29:00.591411 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
